senses.en: costing little money or less than usual
of poor quality and little value

ex.en: We found a cheap café near the train station.
ex.zh: 我们在火车站附近找到了一家价格实惠的咖啡馆。

ex.en: Cheap public transport can improve access to employment and reduce dependence on private cars in large cities.
ex.zh: 价格低廉的公共交通能改善大城市居民的就业可达性，并减少对私家车的依赖。

col: a cheap alternative｜便宜的替代选择
tip: cheap有时暗示质量差；中性表达可用inexpensive。

senses.en: Very good or enjoyable.
Very large in amount, size, or degree.
Highly important, admired, or successful.

ex.en: We had a great afternoon swimming in the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖里游泳，度过了一个愉快的下午。

ex.en: Access to reliable internet is of great importance for students living in remote areas.
ex.zh: 对于居住在偏远地区的学生来说，能够使用可靠的互联网至关重要。

tip: a great deal of后接不可数名词，表示大量。

senses.en: Water that falls from clouds in drops
For water drops to fall from clouds

ex.en: Heavy rain kept us inside for the whole afternoon.
ex.zh: 大雨让我们整个下午都待在屋里。

ex.en: Farmers increasingly depend on stored water because seasonal rain has become less predictable in many regions.
ex.zh: 由于许多地区的季节性降雨越来越难以预测，农民日益依赖储存的水。

col: a chance of rain｜降雨的可能性
tip: rain作名词通常不可数；说下雨用It rains。

senses.en: Of a high or satisfactory standard.
Having a helpful or healthy effect.
Something that benefits people or is morally right.

ex.en: This bakery makes good bread with a crisp crust.
ex.zh: 这家面包店做的面包很好，外皮酥脆。

ex.en: Good public transport allows residents to reach essential services without relying on private cars.
ex.zh: 优质的公共交通让居民无需依赖私家车也能获得基本服务。

tip: good是形容词；修饰动作通常用well。

senses.en: referring to two people or things together
the two people or things already mentioned

ex.en: Both windows were open, letting in the cool breeze.
ex.zh: 两扇窗户都开着，凉风吹了进来。

ex.en: Both governments and individuals have a responsibility to reduce waste and protect natural resources.
ex.zh: 政府和个人都有责任减少浪费并保护自然资源。

tip: both指两者；both A and B作主语用复数谓语。

senses.en: the number 20
the age of 20
the 1920s or 2020s

ex.en: She is twenty years old and studies at a university in the city.
ex.zh: 她二十岁，在城里的一所大学学习。

ex.en: In the twenty-first century, online learning has become common in many schools around the world.
ex.zh: 在二十一世纪，在线学习在世界各地的许多学校中变得普遍。

tip: 注意发音：/ˈtwenti/，不要读成/twənti/。

senses.en: in or into the inner part of something
in or into an enclosed place or container
the inner part or surface of something

ex.en: Your keys are inside the small pocket of your bag.
ex.zh: 你的钥匙在包的小口袋里。

ex.en: Air quality inside buildings deserves greater attention because many people spend most of their day indoors.
ex.zh: 建筑物内部的空气质量值得更多关注，因为许多人一天中的大部分时间都在室内度过。

tip: inside后接名词时是介词；单独用可作副词。

senses.en: the number 90

ex.en: My grandfather is ninety years old but still very active.
ex.zh: 我祖父九十岁了，但仍然很活跃。

ex.en: Nearly ninety percent of the students in our school took part in the charity run.
ex.zh: 我们学校近百分之九十的学生参加了慈善长跑。

tip: 注意拼写：nine 变 ninety 时去 e。

senses.en: A small object used to remove pencil marks.

ex.en: I borrowed an eraser to correct my pencil drawing.
ex.zh: 我借了一块橡皮擦来修改铅笔画。

ex.en: Providing basic classroom supplies, including pencils and erasers, helps ensure that all children can participate in lessons.
ex.zh: 提供铅笔和橡皮擦等基本课堂用品，有助于确保所有孩子都能参与课堂学习。

tip: eraser常用于美式英语；英式英语常说rubber。

senses.en: a journey to a place and usually back again
to stumble or make someone stumble by catching a foot

ex.en: Our weekend trip to the coast was wonderfully relaxing.
ex.zh: 我们周末的海滨之旅让人十分放松。

ex.en: School trips to museums can enrich classroom learning by giving students direct access to historical objects.
ex.zh: 学校组织的博物馆参观能让学生直接接触历史实物，从而丰富课堂学习。

tip: trip 是可数名词；travel 表示旅行活动时通常不可数。

senses.en: A person who controls a car or another road vehicle.
Something that strongly influences or causes a development.
Software that lets a computer communicate with a device.

ex.en: The bus driver waited while I found my ticket.
ex.zh: 公交车司机等着我找到车票。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can be a major driver of economic growth in expanding cities.
ex.zh: 在不断扩张的城市，公共交通投资可以成为经济增长的重要驱动力。

col: a key driver of growth｜增长的关键驱动因素
install a driver｜安装驱动程序
tip: a driver of change指推动变化的因素。

senses.en: the smallest positive whole number
used instead of a countable noun already mentioned
people in general, including the speaker, in formal language

ex.en: There is only one apple left in the bowl.
ex.zh: 碗里只剩一个苹果了。

ex.en: One major benefit of public transport is that it reduces the demand for parking spaces in cities.
ex.zh: 公共交通的一大好处是能减少城市对停车位的需求。

col: one at a time｜一次一个
tip: one可替代单数可数名词；复数用ones。

senses.en: someone who writes books, articles, or other texts

ex.en: The writer filled her notebook while waiting for the train.
ex.zh: 那位作家等火车时，把笔记本写得满满的。

ex.en: A skilled writer can make complex environmental issues accessible to readers without oversimplifying the scientific evidence.
ex.zh: 优秀的作者能让读者理解复杂的环境问题，同时不过度简化科学证据。

tip: writer范围较广；author常指某部作品的作者。

senses.en: Relating to the United Kingdom, its people, or their culture.
The people of the United Kingdom, considered collectively.

ex.en: My British neighbour invited us over for tea.
ex.zh: 我的英国邻居邀请我们过去喝茶。

ex.en: British universities attract international students through their research strengths and the wide range of courses they offer.
ex.zh: 英国大学凭借科研实力和丰富的课程选择吸引国际学生。

tip: 英国人总称用the British；单个人用a Briton。

senses.en: A piece of furniture used for sleeping
The ground at the bottom of a river, sea, or lake
An area of soil prepared for growing plants

ex.en: The cat curled up on my bed after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，猫蜷缩在我的床上。

ex.en: Maintaining a regular time to go to bed can improve sleep quality and support mental health.
ex.zh: 保持固定的就寝时间可以改善睡眠质量，并有益于心理健康。

tip: go to bed指就寝，不加the；make the bed指铺床。

senses.en: Exactly alike, or referring to one particular thing rather than another.
The very thing already mentioned, or something exactly like it.

ex.en: We take the same bus to school every morning.
ex.zh: 我们每天早上乘同一班公交车上学。

ex.en: Students from different backgrounds should have the same opportunities to access high-quality education and develop their talents.
ex.zh: 不同背景的学生应享有同样的机会，接受优质教育并发展自己的才能。

tip: 通常用the same；比较时用the same as。

senses.en: A recording of moving images, usually with sound.
Record moving images of someone or something.

ex.en: We watched a video of penguins sliding across ice.
ex.zh: 我们看了一段企鹅在冰上滑行的视频。

ex.en: Educational video can make complex processes easier to understand, especially for students with limited background knowledge.
ex.zh: 教学视频可以让复杂的过程更容易理解，对背景知识有限的学生尤其如此。

tip: 一段视频用a video；泛指视频媒介时可不可数。

senses.en: at some point within, or throughout, a particular period

ex.en: Please keep your phone silent during the concert.
ex.zh: 音乐会期间请将手机调为静音。

ex.en: During periods of extreme heat, local authorities should provide cool indoor spaces for vulnerable residents.
ex.zh: 在极端高温期间，地方政府应为脆弱群体提供凉爽的室内场所。

col: during working hours｜在工作时间内
tip: during后接名词；while后常接句子；for表示持续时长。

senses.en: a visible mass of tiny water drops in the sky
a mass of smoke, dust, or similar material in air
to make thoughts or judgment less clear

ex.en: A dark cloud drifted slowly across the afternoon sky.
ex.zh: 一朵乌云缓缓飘过午后的天空。

ex.en: Strong emotions can cloud public judgment when communities debate the benefits and risks of new technologies.
ex.zh: 当社区讨论新技术的利弊时，强烈的情绪可能影响公众的判断。

col: a cloud of dust｜一团尘土
cloud someone's judgment｜影响某人的判断
tip: cloud作动词可指使判断不清，如cloud your judgment。

senses.en: Living rather than dead
Full of energy, activity, or excitement

ex.en: The tiny plant is still alive after our holiday.
ex.zh: 我们度假回来后，那株小植物还活着。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats helps keep endangered species alive and preserves the ecological balance of entire regions.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地有助于让濒危物种存活，并维持整个地区的生态平衡。

tip: 通常放在系动词后；“活鱼”说a live fish。

senses.en: A round shape whose edge is equally distant from its centre.
A group of people connected by friendship or shared interests.
To move around something or draw a ring around it.

ex.en: The children sat in a circle on the grass.
ex.zh: 孩子们在草地上围坐成一圈。

ex.en: Joining community activities can help older adults expand their social circle and reduce feelings of isolation.
ex.zh: 参加社区活动可以帮助老年人扩大社交圈，减少孤独感。

tip: circle是圆或圆圈；cycle才常指循环或周期。

senses.en: to cook food in hot oil
a small fish; (pl.) fried potatoes

ex.en: My father likes to fry eggs for breakfast on Sundays.
ex.zh: 我父亲喜欢在周日早餐时煎鸡蛋。

ex.en: If you fry vegetables in too much oil, the dish will become unhealthy.
ex.zh: 如果你用太多油炒蔬菜，这道菜会变得不健康。

tip: fry的过去式和过去分词是fried，如fried rice（炒饭）。

senses.en: Used politely to ask someone to repeat what they said.
To forgive someone or officially release them from punishment.
Official forgiveness for a crime, or forgiveness for an offence.

ex.en: Pardon? I couldn't hear you over the washing machine.
ex.zh: 请再说一遍？洗衣机太吵，我没听清。

ex.en: A legal pardon can help someone rebuild their life, although public acceptance may take longer.
ex.zh: 法律上的赦免可以帮助一个人重建生活，但获得公众接纳可能需要更久。

col: I beg your pardon｜请再说一遍；对不起
tip: 没听清时可说Pardon?，语调通常上扬。

senses.en: with attention and care, so nothing goes wrong

ex.en: Please read the question carefully before you write your answer.
ex.zh: 请在写答案前仔细阅读题目。

ex.en: The team carefully checked the data twice before reporting their results to the class.
ex.zh: 这个小组在向全班报告结果前仔细核对了两次数据。

tip: 副词修饰动词，常放动词后或句首；写作中常用carefully表达严谨。

senses.en: To achieve what you are trying to do.
To take someone's position after they leave it.

ex.en: After several attempts, I succeeded in fixing the lamp.
ex.zh: 尝试了几次后，我终于把灯修好了。

ex.en: Students are more likely to succeed when schools provide consistent feedback and practical support.
ex.zh: 学校持续提供反馈和实际支持时，学生更有可能取得成功。

col: succeed in doing something｜成功做成某事
succeed as a manager｜作为经理取得成功
succeed someone as chair｜接替某人担任主席
tip: 表示成功做成某事，用succeed in doing，不用to do。

senses.en: without difficulty or much effort
by a clear margin, especially in comparisons
with a strong possibility of something happening

ex.en: This small suitcase fits easily beneath the train seat.
ex.zh: 这个小行李箱轻轻松松就能放到火车座位下面。

ex.en: Public information should be presented clearly so that people with different literacy levels can easily understand it.
ex.zh: 公共信息应清晰呈现，让识字水平不同的人都能轻松理解。

col: easily accessible｜容易获取或到达的
easily the best｜无疑是最好的
tip: easily可修饰最高级：easily the best表示远胜其他。

senses.en: A small amount or piece of something.
The smallest unit of information stored by a computer.

ex.en: There is a bit of cake left for you.
ex.zh: 还给你留了一点蛋糕。

ex.en: Even a small bit of practical experience can help students understand difficult scientific concepts.
ex.zh: 即使只有少量实践经验，也能帮助学生理解困难的科学概念。

tip: a bit of接名词；a bit可修饰形容词；bit也是bite过去式。

senses.en: The activity of entering words using a keyboard.

ex.en: My typing has become faster since I started practising.
ex.zh: 开始练习以后，我的打字速度变快了。

ex.en: Although voice recognition is improving, accurate typing remains a valuable skill in many office jobs.
ex.zh: 尽管语音识别技术正在进步，准确打字仍是许多办公室工作中的宝贵技能。

tip: 作名词时不可数；也是type的现在分词。

senses.en: Relating to men or boys, or the sex that produces sperm.
A male person or animal.

ex.en: The male duck has a shiny green head.
ex.zh: 这只公鸭有一个亮闪闪的绿色脑袋。

ex.en: Encouraging more male applicants to enter nursing could help address staff shortages and challenge gender stereotypes.
ex.zh: 鼓励更多男性申请进入护理行业，有助于缓解人员短缺并打破性别刻板印象。

col: male and female｜男性和女性；雄性和雌性
tip: male可作形容词或名词；日常指男人通常用man。

senses.en: A collection of recorded music released as one product.
A book for keeping photographs, stamps or similar collections.

ex.en: Her new album kept us singing all afternoon.
ex.zh: 她的新专辑让我们跟着唱了整整一个下午。

ex.en: Digital platforms allow independent musicians to release an album without relying on a traditional record company.
ex.zh: 数字平台让独立音乐人无需依赖传统唱片公司就能发行专辑。

tip: 音乐专辑用album；单曲用single。

senses.en: a small round disc that stores music or data

ex.en: My grandfather still keeps his music on old CDs.
ex.zh: 我祖父仍把音乐保存在旧光盘里。

ex.en: The school library lends language CDs to students who want to practise listening at home.
ex.zh: 学校图书馆向想在家练习听力的学生出借语言光盘。

col: a collection of CDs｜一批光盘
tip: CD是compact disc的缩写，复数写CDs；读音为/ˌsiːˈdiː/。

senses.en: To produce flames, or destroy something with fire.
To damage skin or other material through heat.
An injury caused by heat, chemicals, or electricity.

ex.en: A small fire burned quietly in the fireplace.
ex.zh: 壁炉里，一小团火静静地燃烧着。

ex.en: Burning fossil fuels releases greenhouse gases, making cleaner energy sources essential for environmental protection.
ex.zh: 燃烧化石燃料会释放温室气体，因此清洁能源对环境保护至关重要。

col: burn fossil fuels｜燃烧化石燃料
tip: 过去式和过去分词可用burnt或burned。

senses.en: to hit a surface, especially a door, to make a sound
to hit something accidentally, often making it move or fall
a sound or blow caused by hitting something

ex.en: Please knock on the door before you come in.
ex.zh: 进来之前请先敲门。

ex.en: Strong winds can knock down trees, causing serious disruption to transport networks in urban areas.
ex.zh: 强风可能刮倒树木，严重扰乱城市地区的交通网络。

col: a loud knock｜响亮的敲击声
tip: 词首k不发音；敲门用knock on或at the door。

senses.en: to move over snow wearing long narrow boards on your feet
a long narrow board worn on a foot for travelling over snow

ex.en: We learned to ski on a gentle snowy slope.
ex.zh: 我们在一处平缓的雪坡上学会了滑雪。

ex.en: Tourists who ski in mountain resorts contribute to local employment but may also increase environmental pressure.
ex.zh: 在山地度假区滑雪的游客促进了当地就业，但也可能增加环境压力。

col: a pair of skis｜一副滑雪板
tip: 过去式skied，现在分词skiing；ski复数为skis。

senses.en: a piece of cloth worn over the front of clothes to keep them clean
the hard area where planes are parked at an airport

ex.en: The cook tied on a clean apron before making the soup.
ex.zh: 厨师在做汤前系上了一条干净的围裙。

ex.en: In the school cooking club, each student wears an apron to protect their clothes from stains.
ex.zh: 在学校烹饪俱乐部里，每个学生都穿围裙，以免衣服被弄脏。

tip: 注意发音/ˈeɪprən/，p不发音；不要拼成aporn。

senses.en: A comfortable shoe with a rubber sole, worn for exercise.

ex.en: One sneaker was hiding under the kitchen chair.
ex.zh: 一只运动鞋藏在厨房的椅子下面。

ex.en: A well-designed sneaker can provide support during exercise, although suitable footwear varies according to the activity.
ex.zh: 设计良好的运动鞋能在锻炼时提供支撑，但适合的鞋类因运动项目而异。

col: a pair of sneakers｜一双运动鞋
tip: 美式常用 sneakers，英式通常说 trainers。

senses.en: a hollow metal object that rings when struck
the ringing sound made by a bell

ex.en: The bicycle bell rang as a cyclist approached.
ex.zh: 一位骑车人靠近时，自行车铃响了。

ex.en: In many schools, a bell marks the beginning and end of each lesson.
ex.zh: 在许多学校，铃声标志着每节课的开始和结束。

tip: ring a bell也可表示“听着耳熟；似曾相识”。

senses.en: in a way that is not dangerous
without much risk of being wrong

ex.en: The children crossed the busy road safely with the help of a guard.
ex.zh: 在护卫的帮助下，孩子们安全地穿过了繁忙的马路。

ex.en: Scientists must test new medicines carefully so that they can be used safely by patients.
ex.zh: 科学家必须仔细检测新药，使病人能安全使用。

tip: 由 safe 加 -ly 构成，注意去 e；反义词 dangerously。

senses.en: plan how something will look or work before making it
the planning of something's appearance or function, or its plan
a decorative pattern on an object or surface

ex.en: My cousin designed a wooden desk for her bedroom.
ex.zh: 我表姐为自己的卧室设计了一张木书桌。

ex.en: Cities should design public spaces that encourage social interaction while remaining accessible to people with disabilities.
ex.zh: 城市应设计既能促进社交互动、又方便残障人士使用的公共空间。

col: be designed to do something｜旨在做某事
tip: be designed to do表示“旨在做……”。

senses.en: giving much light or having a strong, clear colour
quick to learn and understand things
promising success or showing happiness

ex.en: Bright sunlight streamed through the kitchen window this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，明亮的阳光从厨房窗户照了进来。

ex.en: Access to quality education can give young people a bright future regardless of their family background.
ex.zh: 无论家庭背景如何，获得优质教育都能让年轻人拥有光明的未来。

tip: 形容光线强用bright；形容房间暗用dim。

senses.en: A person who manages workers or runs a business.
To order people around in an annoying or controlling way.

ex.en: My boss let me leave early for my appointment.
ex.zh: 我的上司允许我提前下班去赴约。

ex.en: A supportive boss can improve employee satisfaction by offering constructive feedback and recognising individual contributions.
ex.zh: 支持员工的上司可以通过提供建设性反馈和认可个人贡献来提高员工满意度。

col: talk to your boss｜与你的上司交谈
a supportive boss｜支持员工的上司
be your own boss｜自己当老板
boss someone around｜对某人指手画脚
tip: boss较口语；作动词常用boss someone around。

senses.en: A four-stringed instrument held under the chin and usually bowed.

ex.en: My sister practises the violin after dinner every evening.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天晚饭后都练习小提琴。

ex.en: Learning the violin can help children develop concentration, although regular lessons may be expensive for some families.
ex.zh: 学习小提琴有助于儿童培养专注力，但定期上课对某些家庭来说可能费用较高。

col: a violin concerto｜小提琴协奏曲
tip: 小提琴手是violinist；拉小提琴常说play the violin。

senses.en: speaking or behaving without respect for others

ex.en: It was rude to interrupt her during dinner.
ex.zh: 吃晚饭时打断她说话很不礼貌。

ex.en: Schools should teach children how to disagree respectfully without making rude comments about others.
ex.zh: 学校应该教孩子如何礼貌地表达不同意见，而不是对他人出言不逊。

tip: 对某人无礼用 rude to someone，不用 rude with。

senses.en: A hand covering with separate sections for fingers and thumb.

ex.en: I found my missing glove under the kitchen chair.
ex.zh: 我在厨房椅子下面找到了丢失的那只手套。

ex.en: Healthcare workers should change disposable gloves between patients to reduce the risk of spreading infections.
ex.zh: 医护人员在接诊不同患者之间应更换一次性手套，以降低传播感染的风险。

col: a pair of gloves｜一副手套
tip: 一副手套用 a pair of gloves，注意 gloves 用复数。

senses.en: to finish doing something or filling in information
having every necessary part, with nothing missing
total, without any limit or exception

ex.en: I completed the puzzle just before dinner was ready.
ex.zh: 我刚拼好拼图，晚饭就做好了。

ex.en: Students who complete vocational training often gain practical skills that help them enter the workforce more confidently.
ex.zh: 完成职业培训的学生往往能获得实用技能，从而更有信心地进入职场。

tip: complete a form指填写完表格，不是制作表格。

senses.en: to touch someone or something with your lips affectionately
an affectionate touch made with the lips

ex.en: She kissed her daughter gently before leaving for work.
ex.zh: 她上班前轻轻亲了亲女儿。

ex.en: In some cultures, a kiss on the cheek is a common greeting between close friends.
ex.zh: 在一些文化中，亲吻脸颊是亲密朋友之间常见的问候方式。

col: kiss someone goodbye｜亲吻某人道别
give someone a kiss｜亲某人一下
a kiss on the cheek｜脸颊上的一吻
tip: 吻某人的脸颊用 kiss someone on the cheek。

senses.en: Room available for something, or a gap between things
The vast area beyond Earth's atmosphere
To arrange things with gaps between them

ex.en: There is enough space for your bike beside mine.
ex.zh: 我的自行车旁边有足够的地方放你的车。

ex.en: Providing more green space in crowded neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and encourage outdoor physical activity.
ex.zh: 在人口密集的社区增加绿地，可以改善居民身心健康并鼓励户外锻炼。

tip: 泛指空间、太空时不可数；具体车位等可数。

senses.en: To make the sounds of a word when speaking.
To state an official decision or judgment.

ex.en: Could you teach me how to pronounce your name?
ex.zh: 你能教我怎么读你的名字吗？

ex.en: Language learners often find unfamiliar sounds easier to pronounce after regular listening practice and feedback.
ex.zh: 经过规律的听力练习并获得反馈后，语言学习者往往会觉得陌生的音更容易发准。

col: pronounce someone innocent｜宣布某人无罪
tip: 名词是pronunciation，注意中间没有字母o。

senses.en: the skill or power needed to do something

ex.en: Her ability to fix bicycles impressed all her friends.
ex.zh: 她修自行车的本领让朋友们都很佩服。

ex.en: Regular reading can strengthen children's ability to understand complex ideas and express their own views clearly.
ex.zh: 经常阅读可以增强儿童理解复杂概念和清晰表达自身观点的能力。

col: the ability to learn｜学习能力
develop an ability｜培养一种能力
tip: 表示“做某事的能力”用ability to do。

senses.en: a device that captures sound, images, or information
a wooden or plastic wind instrument with finger holes
a person who keeps an official record

ex.en: I placed the recorder beside her before the interview.
ex.zh: 采访前，我把录音机放在她身旁。

ex.en: Using a digital recorder allows researchers to review interviews carefully and identify recurring themes.
ex.zh: 使用数字录音机使研究人员能够仔细回顾访谈，识别反复出现的主题。

tip: play the recorder指吹竖笛，不是播放录音机。

senses.en: a common grey and white bird that lives near the sea

ex.en: A seagull landed on the wall and looked at our sandwiches.
ex.zh: 一只海鸥落在墙上，看着我们的三明治。

ex.en: Scientists found that seagull numbers near the harbour had fallen sharply over the past ten years.
ex.zh: 科学家发现，过去十年港口附近的海鸥数量大幅下降。

col: a flock of seagulls｜一群海鸥
tip: seagull常说gull，指海边常见的灰白色鸟。

senses.en: following the length or direction of something
forward from one place towards another
with someone when they go somewhere

ex.en: We walked along the river and watched the ducks.
ex.zh: 我们沿着河边散步，看着水里的鸭子。

ex.en: Planting trees along busy roads can provide shade for pedestrians and improve the appearance of urban areas.
ex.zh: 在繁忙道路沿线植树可以为行人遮阴，并改善城市面貌。

col: bring someone along｜带某人一起来
tip: along沿着长线走；across强调从一边横穿到另一边。

senses.en: A formal, polite way of addressing a woman.

ex.en: Would you like a table by the window, madam?
ex.zh: 女士，您想坐靠窗的桌子吗？

ex.en: In formal customer service settings, staff may address a female customer as madam to show respect.
ex.zh: 在正式的客户服务场合，工作人员可能用madam称呼女性顾客，以示尊重。

tip: 正式称呼女性时使用；日常熟人交谈中通常不用。

senses.en: failed to catch, attend, or take advantage of something
failed to hit or notice someone or something
felt sad because someone or something was absent

ex.en: We missed the bus and walked home together.
ex.zh: 我们没赶上公交车，便一起走回了家。

ex.en: Students who missed lessons due to illness should receive additional support to catch up with their classmates.
ex.zh: 因病缺课的学生应获得额外帮助，以跟上同学的学习进度。

tip: miss的过去式和过去分词；词尾-ed读/t/。

senses.en: A valuable yellow metal used for jewellery and money
The medal awarded for first place in a competition
Made of gold or having its yellow colour

ex.en: My grandmother keeps her gold ring in a wooden box.
ex.zh: 我奶奶把她的金戒指放在一个木盒里。

ex.en: Demand for gold can increase during economic uncertainty, as investors seek assets they consider relatively safe.
ex.zh: 经济不确定时期，投资者会寻求他们认为相对安全的资产，黄金需求因此可能上升。

tip: gold作材料名通常不可数；a gold可指一枚金牌。

senses.en: the way a word or language is spoken

ex.en: I practise my pronunciation by recording short voice messages.
ex.zh: 我通过录制简短的语音消息练习发音。

ex.en: Clear pronunciation helps language learners communicate effectively, even when their grammar is not always accurate.
ex.zh: 即使语法并非总是准确，清晰的发音也能帮助语言学习者有效沟通。

tip: 拼写是pronunciation，注意中间不是noun。

senses.en: Learning and practice that develop skills for a particular activity.
Physical exercise and practice to prepare for sport.

ex.en: My first day of training involved helping customers.
ex.zh: 培训第一天，我就参与了为顾客提供帮助的工作。

ex.en: Regular professional training helps employees adapt to technological changes and improves their long-term career prospects.
ex.zh: 定期职业培训有助于员工适应技术变化，并改善他们的长期职业前景。

tip: 通常不可数；一次培训可说a training session。

senses.en: a thin, flat piece cut from something larger
to cut something into thin, flat pieces
a share or portion of something

ex.en: She put a slice of lemon in my tea.
ex.zh: 她在我的茶里放了一片柠檬。

ex.en: Housing costs consume a large slice of household income, leaving many families with little money for leisure.
ex.zh: 住房开支占据家庭收入的很大一部分，使许多家庭几乎没有钱用于休闲。

col: a slice of bread｜一片面包
a slice of the market｜一部分市场份额
tip: slice强调切出的片；piece泛指一块或一件。

senses.en: The food and drink someone regularly consumes.
A planned way of eating for health or weight control.
To control what you eat, usually to lose weight.

ex.en: My usual diet includes plenty of rice and vegetables.
ex.zh: 我的日常饮食中有大量米饭和蔬菜。

ex.en: A balanced diet can improve concentration and help students maintain their energy throughout the school day.
ex.zh: 均衡饮食能提高注意力，并帮助学生在整个上学期间保持精力。

col: a diet rich in fibre｜富含纤维的饮食
go on a diet｜开始节食
tip: diet不一定指节食，也可指日常饮食。

senses.en: Relating to the Netherlands, its people, or their language.
The language spoken in the Netherlands and parts of Belgium.
The people of the Netherlands, considered as a group.

ex.en: Our Dutch neighbour taught us how to bake apple pie.
ex.zh: 我们的荷兰邻居教我们烤苹果派。

ex.en: Dutch cities are often studied by urban planners seeking to develop safer and more accessible cycling networks.
ex.zh: 希望建设更安全、更便利的自行车交通网络的城市规划者经常研究荷兰城市。

tip: Dutch首字母大写；the Dutch统指荷兰人。

senses.en: a smaller amount of something
to a smaller degree or extent
a smaller amount

ex.en: Please put less sugar in my tea this time.
ex.zh: 这次请在我的茶里少放点糖。

ex.en: Households can use less energy by improving insulation and choosing appliances that consume electricity more efficiently.
ex.zh: 家庭可以通过改善隔热措施和选用更节能的电器来减少能源消耗。

tip: 修饰不可数名词用less；可数名词复数通常用fewer。

senses.en: A country's military force trained mainly to fight on land.
A large group of people working toward a shared purpose.

ex.en: My cousin joined the army after leaving school.
ex.zh: 我的表亲毕业后参军了。

ex.en: During major floods, the army can provide essential transport and supplies when civilian services are overwhelmed.
ex.zh: 发生严重洪灾时，如果民用服务不堪重负，军队可以提供必要的运输服务和物资。

col: serve in the army｜在陆军服役
an army of volunteers｜大批志愿者
tip: army主要指陆军；armed forces泛指各军种。

senses.en: Damaged by being split or separated into pieces.
Not working properly because of damage.
Spoken with difficulty and frequent pauses or errors.

ex.en: She carefully swept the broken glass into a dustpan.
ex.zh: 她小心地把碎玻璃扫进簸箕里。

ex.en: Repairing broken household appliances rather than replacing them can reduce waste and conserve valuable natural resources.
ex.zh: 维修损坏的家用电器而非更换它们，可以减少废弃物并节约宝贵的自然资源。

col: a broken promise｜未兑现的承诺
tip: 也是break的过去分词；过去式为broke。

senses.en: a large area of land covered mainly with trees

ex.en: We followed a narrow path deep into the forest.
ex.zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路走进森林深处。

ex.en: Protecting natural forests helps preserve biodiversity and reduces the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.
ex.zh: 保护天然森林有助于维护生物多样性，并减少大气中的二氧化碳含量。

tip: forest通常指大片森林；wood也可指较小树林。

senses.en: finely chopped meat enclosed in a thin, tube-shaped skin

ex.en: We grilled sausages and served them with fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 我们烤了香肠，配上新鲜蔬菜端上桌。

ex.en: Consumers are increasingly choosing vegetarian sausages as they seek alternatives to traditional meat products.
ex.zh: 随着消费者寻找传统肉制品的替代品，越来越多人开始选择素香肠。

tip: 单根香肠可数；sausage meat指香肠肉馅，不可数。

senses.en: To plan and arrange an event or activity
To arrange things in a clear, useful order

ex.en: Our neighbours organized a picnic by the river.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居组织了一次河边野餐。

ex.en: Schools should organize practical workshops that help students develop communication skills and prepare for employment.
ex.zh: 学校应组织实践工作坊，帮助学生培养沟通技能并为就业做好准备。

col: organize your time｜合理安排时间
tip: 英式也常拼作organise；organize是规范拼写。

senses.en: coming after the fifteenth
one of sixteen equal parts

ex.en: Her birthday is on the sixteenth of March.
ex.zh: 她的生日是三月十六日。

ex.en: By the sixteenth century, printing had spread across much of Europe, changing how people learned new ideas.
ex.zh: 到十六世纪，印刷术已传遍欧洲大部分地区，改变了人们学习新思想的方式。

col: on the sixteenth of May｜五月十六日
tip: 序数词前通常加 the；日期写作 the 16th 或 the sixteenth。

senses.en: an animal like a small horse with long ears

ex.en: A grey donkey carried baskets along the narrow mountain path.
ex.zh: 一头灰驴驮着篮子走在狭窄的山路上。

ex.en: In some rural communities, donkeys remain important for transporting goods where roads are unsuitable for vehicles.
ex.zh: 在一些乡村社区，道路不适合车辆通行，驴仍是运输货物的重要工具。

tip: 指动物时donkey最常用；用来称呼人有贬义。

senses.en: living or growing naturally, without human care
showing strong excitement or uncontrolled behaviour
natural places where animals and plants live freely

ex.en: We spotted wild deer drinking beside the forest stream.
ex.zh: 我们看见野鹿在森林的小溪旁喝水。

ex.en: Protecting wild animals requires governments to preserve habitats and reduce illegal trade across national borders.
ex.zh: 保护野生动物需要各国政府保护栖息地，并减少跨境非法贸易。

tip: 表示“在野外”用in the wild，不能漏掉the。

senses.en: relating to society and how people live together
relating to meeting people and spending time with them
living naturally in organised groups rather than alone

ex.en: My new job leaves little time for social activities.
ex.zh: 我的新工作让我几乎没时间参加社交活动。

ex.en: Affordable housing policies can reduce social inequality by helping families access safe homes near essential services.
ex.zh: 可负担住房政策帮助家庭在基本服务设施附近获得安全住所，从而减少社会不平等。

tip: social指社会或社交的；sociable指人爱交际。

senses.en: a female police officer

ex.en: The policewoman helped the lost child find his parents.
ex.zh: 女警察帮助走失的孩子找到了父母。

ex.en: She dreamed of becoming a policewoman after watching a TV series about crime solving.
ex.zh: 她看了关于破案的电视剧后，梦想成为一名女警察。

col: a brave policewoman｜一位勇敢的女警察
tip: 现代英语中 police officer 更常用，以避免性别区分。

senses.en: An opening through something or a hollow space in the ground.
A weakness or missing part in a plan or argument.

ex.en: There's a small hole in my favourite sock.
ex.zh: 我最喜欢的袜子上有一个小洞。

ex.en: The discovery of a hole in the safety fence prompted residents to request urgent repairs.
ex.zh: 安全围栏上发现了一个破洞，促使居民要求紧急维修。

col: a hole in the ground｜地上的坑
tip: hole指洞；whole指完整的，两词同音。

senses.en: The currency used by many countries in the European Union.

ex.en: I found a euro in my coat pocket today.
ex.zh: 今天我在外套口袋里发现了一枚一欧元硬币。

ex.en: Using the euro allows tourists to visit several European countries without exchanging money at each border.
ex.zh: 使用欧元让游客能够游览多个欧洲国家，而不必每过一次边境就兑换货币。

tip: 普通英语中复数通常为euros；并非所有欧盟国家都用欧元。

senses.en: A piece of furniture with shelves for books.

ex.en: She keeps her favourite novels in a wooden bookcase.
ex.zh: 她把最喜欢的小说放在一个木书柜里。

ex.en: Placing accessible bookcases in classrooms can encourage children to read independently during their free time.
ex.zh: 在教室里摆放方便取书的书柜，可以鼓励孩子在空闲时间自主阅读。

col: a bookcase full of books｜装满书的书柜
tip: bookcase指整件书柜，bookshelf指书架或一层搁板。

senses.en: the capital city of Japan

ex.en: My uncle will fly to Tokyo for a work meeting.
ex.zh: 我叔叔要飞往东京开工作会。

ex.en: Tokyo is one of the largest cities in the world, with a huge and busy transport system.
ex.zh: 东京是世界上最大的城市之一，拥有庞大繁忙的交通系统。

tip: 专有名词首字母大写；注意英语拼写是 Tokyo，不是 Tokio。

senses.en: an instruction stating what is allowed or required
control of a country or people by a leader or group
to govern a country or make an official legal decision

ex.en: Our main rule is to leave muddy shoes outside.
ex.zh: 我们最主要的规矩是把沾泥的鞋子留在外面。

ex.en: Clear rules on industrial waste disposal are essential for protecting rivers and ensuring safe drinking water.
ex.zh: 关于工业废物处理的明确规定对于保护河流和保障饮用水安全至关重要。

tip: as a rule意为“通常”；rule out意为“排除”。

senses.en: a tool with bristles used for cleaning, painting or arranging hair
to clean, paint or arrange something using a brush
to touch something lightly while moving past it

ex.en: Use a soft brush to clean your muddy shoes.
ex.zh: 用软毛刷清理你沾满泥的鞋子。

ex.en: Children should learn to brush their teeth properly, as good habits can prevent many dental problems.
ex.zh: 儿童应学会正确刷牙，因为良好的习惯可以预防许多牙齿问题。

tip: brush against表示轻擦；brush up on表示温习。

senses.en: Feeling pleased about achievements or people you care about.
Believing you are better or more important than others.

ex.en: He felt proud of the cake he baked himself.
ex.zh: 他为自己亲手烤出的蛋糕感到自豪。

ex.en: Residents are often proud of their cultural heritage and support efforts to preserve historic buildings.
ex.zh: 居民往往为自己的文化遗产感到自豪，并支持保护历史建筑的行动。

col: proud to be｜以身为……而自豪
too proud to ask｜太好面子而不肯问
tip: be proud of后接名词或动名词，表示为……自豪。

senses.en: the time when you usually go to bed

ex.en: My little brother's bedtime is eight o'clock on school nights.
ex.zh: 上学日的晚上，我弟弟八点就寝。

ex.en: Doctors say looking at a phone before bedtime can make it harder to fall asleep.
ex.zh: 医生说，睡前看手机会让人更难入睡。

tip: 固定搭配 bedtime story（睡前故事）；bedtime 常作不可数名词用。

senses.en: Easy to understand or do; not complicated.
Plain and without unnecessary decoration or extra features.

ex.en: This simple recipe takes just ten minutes to prepare.
ex.zh: 这道简单的菜只需十分钟就能做好。

ex.en: Schools should provide simple instructions so that all students can complete classroom tasks independently.
ex.zh: 学校应提供简单易懂的说明，让所有学生都能独立完成课堂任务。

tip: simple可指容易或朴素，不一定表示简陋。

senses.en: Up to now, especially in questions and negative statements.
But, despite what has just been stated.
Used to emphasize a further increase or addition.

ex.en: I haven't finished dinner yet, so please wait.
ex.zh: 我还没吃完晚饭，请等一下。

ex.en: Renewable energy is becoming cheaper, yet many countries still depend heavily on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 可再生能源正在变得更便宜，然而许多国家仍严重依赖化石燃料。

tip: 表示“还未”常用于否定句末；疑问句中可表示“已经”。

senses.en: decorative objects worn on the body, such as rings and necklaces

ex.en: She keeps her jewelry in a small wooden box.
ex.zh: 她把首饰放在一个小木盒里。

ex.en: Consumers increasingly want assurance that the materials used in jewelry are sourced responsibly and without environmental damage.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越希望得到保证：首饰所用材料的来源负责任，且不损害环境。

col: a piece of jewelry｜一件首饰
tip: 美式拼写，英式为jewellery；不可数，用piece计件。

senses.en: The amount of space between two places or things
A lack of emotional closeness between people
To separate yourself from someone, something, or their views

ex.en: The distance from our house to school is quite short.
ex.zh: 从我们家到学校的距离很短。

ex.en: Reducing the distance between residential areas and workplaces could lower transport emissions and improve urban quality of life.
ex.zh: 缩短住宅区与工作地点之间的距离，可以减少交通排放并改善城市生活质量。

tip: in the distance指在远处；at a distance指隔一段距离。

senses.en: Below the ground, or operating secretly.
Below the ground, or in a hidden, secret way.
A railway system running mainly beneath a city.

ex.en: We left our car in an underground garage.
ex.zh: 我们把车停在了地下车库。

ex.en: Underground transport systems can ease congestion, although constructing tunnels requires substantial investment and careful planning.
ex.zh: 地铁交通系统能缓解拥堵，但隧道建设需要大量投资和周密规划。

tip: 名词表地铁主要用于英式英语，此时重音在首音节。

senses.en: to say that you will not do or accept something
unwanted waste material that people throw away

ex.en: She refused to leave without her favourite blue umbrella.
ex.zh: 不带上她最喜欢的蓝色雨伞，她就不肯走。

ex.en: Local authorities may refuse permission for developments that threaten wildlife habitats or increase flood risks.
ex.zh: 地方政府可能拒绝批准威胁野生动物栖息地或增加洪灾风险的开发项目。

col: refuse to do something｜拒绝做某事
tip: 名词读/ˈrefjuːs/；动词后接to do，不接doing。

senses.en: unwilling to work or make an effort
relaxed and involving little activity

ex.en: I felt too lazy to cook dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚我懒得做饭。

ex.en: Students who struggle with homework should not automatically be considered lazy, as learning difficulties may be involved.
ex.zh: 不应一概认为做作业有困难的学生懒惰，因为这可能涉及学习障碍。

tip: lazy afternoon指悠闲的午后，不一定含贬义。

senses.en: Making someone feel afraid or nervous.

ex.en: That scary noise was just a branch against the window.
ex.zh: 那个吓人的声音只不过是树枝在碰窗户。

ex.en: Starting school can be scary for young children, so teachers should create a welcoming environment.
ex.zh: 开始上学可能让年幼的孩子害怕，因此教师应营造友善的环境。

tip: scary形容事物吓人；scared形容人感到害怕。

senses.en: the son of your son or daughter

ex.en: Her grandson visits every Sunday and helps with cooking.
ex.zh: 她的孙子每周日都来看她，并帮忙做饭。

ex.en: Regular contact with a grandson or granddaughter can help older adults feel more socially connected.
ex.zh: 经常与孙辈联系能帮助老年人增强与社会的联系感。

col: youngest grandson｜最小的孙子或外孙
eldest grandson｜最大的孙子或外孙
tip: 不区分父系与母系，既指孙子也指外孙。

senses.zh: 在任何地方；去任何地方
senses.en: in or to any place
in any place, used in questions and negative statements

ex.en: You can sit anywhere you like in this room.
ex.zh: 在这个房间里，你想坐哪儿都行。

ex.en: Reliable internet access allows employees to work from anywhere, reducing the need for daily commuting.
ex.zh: 可靠的网络连接使员工能够在任何地方工作，减少了每天通勤的必要。

tip: 不定副词，通常不直接作名词；anywhere else指别处。

senses.en: a cloth symbol representing a country, group, or organisation
to mark something as needing attention
to become weaker or less energetic

ex.en: A bright flag fluttered above the school gate.
ex.zh: 一面鲜艳的旗帜在校门上方飘扬。

ex.en: Teachers should flag potential learning difficulties early so that students can receive appropriate support.
ex.zh: 教师应尽早指出潜在的学习困难，以便学生获得适当的支持。

tip: 动词过去式flagged，进行式flagging，双写g。

senses.en: A piece of jewellery worn on the ear.

ex.en: She wore a pair of silver earrings to the party.
ex.zh: 她戴着一对银色耳环去参加聚会。

ex.en: In some cultures, earrings are a traditional gift for a baby girl.
ex.zh: 在某些文化中，耳环是送给女婴的传统礼物。

col: a pair of earrings｜一对耳环
tip: 通常用复数 a pair of earrings 表示一对耳环。

senses.en: To become someone's husband or wife.
To perform the ceremony that makes two people legally married.

ex.en: My cousin plans to marry her partner next spring.
ex.zh: 我表姐计划明年春天与伴侣结婚。

ex.en: Many young adults choose to marry later because they want financial stability before starting a family.
ex.zh: 许多年轻人选择晚婚，因为他们希望在组建家庭前拥有稳定的经济基础。

tip: 说marry someone或get married to，不说marry with。

senses.en: Coming after sixth and before eighth in an ordered sequence.
One of seven equal parts of something.

ex.en: Our new flat is on the seventh floor.
ex.zh: 我们的新公寓在七楼。

ex.en: By the seventh week of the course, students were able to analyse basic scientific data independently.
ex.zh: 到课程第七周时，学生已能独立分析基本的科学数据。

tip: 序数词前通常用the；已有物主限定词时不用the。

senses.en: existing in nature rather than made by people
having an ability from birth rather than through training
normal and expected in a particular situation

ex.en: This soap is made entirely from natural ingredients.
ex.zh: 这块肥皂完全由天然原料制成。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for maintaining biodiversity and supporting communities that depend on local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地对于维持生物多样性、支持依赖当地生态系统的社区至关重要。

tip: natural指天然的；nature是名词，指自然。

senses.en: The activity of growing and caring for plants in gardens.

ex.en: My grandmother enjoys gardening on cool spring mornings.
ex.zh: 我奶奶喜欢在凉爽的春日早晨打理花园。

ex.en: Community gardening can improve urban environments while helping residents develop stronger social connections.
ex.zh: 社区园艺既能改善城市环境，也能帮助居民建立更紧密的社会联系。

tip: 通常为不可数名词：do some gardening。

senses.en: The sport of riding waves while standing on a board.
The activity of browsing websites on the internet.

ex.en: We went surfing at the beach early this morning.
ex.zh: 今天一大早我们去海滩冲浪了。

ex.en: The growing popularity of surfing can support coastal economies while increasing pressure on fragile marine environments.
ex.zh: 冲浪运动日益流行，既能促进沿海经济，也会加大脆弱海洋环境承受的压力。

tip: 运动用go surfing；网上浏览也可说surf the internet。

senses.en: A person who uses a product, service, or facility.

ex.en: Each user can choose a different colour for their profile.
ex.zh: 每位用户都可以为自己的个人资料选择不同的颜色。

ex.en: Software developers should consider the needs of every user, including people with limited technical skills.
ex.zh: 软件开发者应考虑每位用户的需求，包括技术能力有限的人。

tip: use作动词及user中的s读/z/。

senses.en: a long board that goes up and down for children to play on
to move up and down or change repeatedly

ex.en: The two children laughed as they played on the see-saw.
ex.zh: 两个孩子玩跷跷板时开心地笑了。

ex.en: Prices of vegetables often see-saw during the year because of changes in weather and supply.
ex.zh: 由于天气和供应变化，蔬菜价格一年中常常上下波动。

tip: 英式常用see-saw，美式口语常说teeter-totter。

senses.en: An urban railway system that often runs underground.

ex.en: We took the metro to the museum this morning.
ex.zh: 今天上午，我们乘地铁去了博物馆。

ex.en: Expanding the metro could reduce traffic congestion by providing residents with a reliable alternative to private cars.
ex.zh: 扩建地铁能为居民提供可靠的私家车替代出行方式，从而缓解交通拥堵。

tip: metro不限于法国；乘地铁常说take the metro。

senses.en: To prevent someone or something from being harmed or lost.
To use less of something or keep money for later.
To keep something for future use, especially computer data.

ex.en: The lifeguard saved a child from the deep water.
ex.zh: 救生员从深水中救起了一个孩子。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can save commuters time and reduce household travel costs.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以节省通勤者的时间，并降低家庭出行成本。

tip: save money既可指省钱，也可指存钱。
